title: History
summary: Mountain Blue's history page, which gives a founding year of 1975. The company's home page gives 1978 for the same business.
why_it_matters: Two pages on the same corporate website give different founding years. This is recorded as a conflicting claim rather than resolved, because no independent registry source was retrieved that settles it.

reading.rationale: Short, but the internal contradiction is worth noting.

commercial_position.rationale: Founding year has little competitive weight.
